name: Navy primary-care physician retention — research figure and lab
tone: Evidence-first academic analysis; clear labels and explicit source limits.

layout.figure: Three specialty panels, four annual points each
layout.axis: Cumulative civilian benchmark minus Navy cash; zero line in every panel
layout.scale: Panel-specific dollar scales, disclosed in caption
layout.caption: Source years, constant-dollar assumption, Marit comparability limit, and no retention effect claim

rules: Every plotted point reconciles to the 12-row CSV.
Use the same color for each policy across all specialty panels.
Label negative cash gaps as Navy above the published benchmark.
The figure must remain legible when exported for the paper.
Do not imply that closing a pay gap measures retention or labor-supply elasticity.
